passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long phrase beats something short with symbols.
locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait {minutes} min and try again.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: This panel can write to your blog: log in with your username and password.
login.noPassword: There are no users yet: create the first one, it will be the admin.
login.forgot: Forgot it? Ask an admin for a link to change it, or on the server: ghost-connector auth password <username>
login.resetDone: Password changed. Log in with it and your app code.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.hint: Or one of your recovery codes (xxxxx-xxxxx) if you don't have your phone.

setup.title: Create the first user
setup.intro: It will be the panel's admin. From now on you log in with a username and password; later you can invite more people from Settings → Users.

security.offBody: Highly recommended: the panel holds your keys and can publish to your blog. With 2FA, a leaked password isn't enough to get in.
security.codeToManage: To manage it, type a code from the app (or a recovery code).

enroll.title: Enable two-step verification
enroll.intro: With an authenticator app: Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, Bitwarden…
enroll.step1: Scan the QR code with the app.
enroll.step2: Can't scan it? Add the account by hand with this key:
enroll.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.
enroll.wrong: That code doesn't match. Check that your phone's clock is right and try the next one.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes works once instead of the app's.
recovery.once: Save them now (in your password manager, for example): they won't be shown again.
recovery.copyFailed: Couldn't copy them: select them by hand.

nag.text: Enable two-step verification: the panel holds your keys and can write to your blog.

notices.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were logged out.
notices.recoveryUsed: You logged in with a recovery code: it no longer works. If you have few left, generate new ones.
notices.badPassword: The current password is not correct.
notices.weakPassword: The new password is too short or doesn't match when repeated.

adminOnly: This part is for admins only. Ask an admin to change it.

errors.badUsername: The username must have 2 to 64 characters: letters, digits or . _ @ + -
errors.lastAdmin: The panel needs at least one admin.
errors.notFound: That link is no longer valid.
errors.owner: Not possible on the owner: transfer the ownership first.

invite.title: Join the panel
invite.intro: {by} invited you as {role}. Choose your username and password.
invite.resetIntro: Choose a new password for your account. Your other sessions will be closed.
invite.gone: This link was already used, expired or was revoked. Ask a panel admin for a new one.

account.title: My account
account.totpOn: Logging in asks for a code from your app.
account.passwordIntro: Changing it closes your other sessions.
account.sessionsIntro: Where you have the panel open. If you don't recognise one, close it and change your password.
account.activityIntro: Your logins, failed attempts with your username and security changes.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Who can log in to the panel. Each person has their own username, password and 2FA, and the history records who did what.
users.reset2faBody: For when they lost their phone and recovery codes. Their sessions are closed and they log in with just the password until they enable it again.
users.deleteBody: They can no longer log in and their sessions are closed. What they did stays in the history under their name.
users.rolesHelp: Editor: plans, reviews, edits, applies to Ghost, ideas and jobs. Admin: also Settings (prompts, behaviour) and editors. Owner (one): also keys, export/import and admins.
users.linkOnce: Copy it now and send it through a private channel: it is not shown again. Single use, valid for {days} days.
users.linkHelp: Whoever opens it chooses their password and logs in. You can revoke it in Settings → Users until it is used.

notices.lastAdmin: Not possible: the panel would be left without an admin.
notices.self: That can't be done to your own account: use My account or ask another admin.
notices.transferred: Ownership transferred. You are now an admin.
notices.owner: Only the owner can do that, and never on their own account.

users.transferBody: {name} becomes the owner (keys, export/import, managing admins) and you become an admin. Type your password to confirm.
users.onlyOwnerAdmins: Only the owner can invite or manage admins.

roleBody.admin: {name} will be able to manage editors and settings (keys and export stay owner-only).
roleBody.editor: {name} will no longer manage users or settings, and keeps working on drafts.

ownerOnly: Only the panel owner can do this.
tooMany: Too many attempts from here. Wait a few minutes.
busy: The server is busy checking passwords. Try again in a few seconds.
